_readme: Queries whose answers should be findable in the corpus in corpus/. 'expected_terms' is what keyword precision is scored against and every term below was verified present in the corpus before this file was written. 'must_come_from' is deliberately NOT filled in: naming which chunk holds each answer is hand-verification work, it is the thing that makes recall measurable, and inventing it would make every number downstream meaningless.

_corpus.topic: Postmastectomy breast reconstruction - incision location and nipple viability in nipple-sparing mastectomy
_corpus.note_on_dimension: The shipped embeddings.npy is 3072-dimensional and querying it requires an OpenAI key, because the QUERY has to be embedded by the same model. Only chunk_meta.jsonl is shipped here, so re-embed the text locally (Ollama nomic-embed-text is 768-dim) and record the model and dimension you used. Numbers produced at 768 CANNOT be compared with numbers produced at 3072 - the vectors live in different spaces.

_warning_corpus_vs_benchmark: This corpus is about BREAST RECONSTRUCTION. The 20 questions in 04-benchmarks/clinical-retrieval/questions.py are about BURNS and WOUNDS. They do not match, and running those questions against this corpus will return near-zero retrieval - which would look like a broken harness and is not. Use the queries below with this corpus; use questions.py with a burns/wounds corpus.
_provenance: Queries derived from the frozen protocol protocol_pico.json, domain 10, clinical_question and its five outcomes. The protocol is SHA-256 frozen, so these are pre-registered questions rather than questions written to fit an answer.

queries.query: In patients undergoing nipple-sparing mastectomy, does incision location affect rates of nipple and skin flap necrosis?
queries.source: protocol_pico.json domain 10 - the domain's own clinical question

queries.query: What is the rate of total nipple necrosis by incision type after nipple-sparing mastectomy?
What is the rate of partial nipple necrosis by incision type after nipple-sparing mastectomy?
How does skin flap necrosis compare between inframammary fold and periareolar incisions?
What odds ratios are reported for necrosis by incision type in nipple-sparing mastectomy?
queries.source: protocol_pico.json domain 10 - the effect measure the domain's evidence is graded on

_term_verification.method: substring count over the text and embed_text fields of all 680 chunks
_term_verification.note: Every expected_term above appears in the corpus, so a zero score means retrieval missed it - not that the term was never there. 'reconstructive failure' occurs only 4 times, which is why no query above is scored on it alone.

_your_next_step: Fill must_come_from and verified_by by hand, for at least a few queries. Open the corpus, find the chunk that actually contains the answer, and record its chunk_id. Until that exists you can measure keyword precision but you CANNOT measure recall, because recall asks 'did the right chunk come back' and nothing yet defines which chunk is right.
